strategy_roster.name: OBV Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: OBV is cumulative state and unavailable, so volume_ratio(20) stands in for it: a cross above its prior 20-value maximum is the documented breakout, gated by a rising close, and the cross of its 20-period mean is the documented OBV-MA exit. Both documented lookbacks of 20 are used; the stop distance is not quantified in the docs.

strategy_roster.name: Simple MACD
strategy_roster.notes: The documented rule compares the two most recent MACD readings, so a positive one-bar return of the MACD line with the documented FastPeriod 12 and SlowPeriod 26 buys and a negative return sells. The SignalPeriod 9 line is only retained for compatibility in the source and the reversal sizing logic is a volume module.

strategy_roster.name: TrueSort 1001
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma(close, 10) > sma(close, 20) and sma(close, 20) > sma(close, 50) and sma(close, 50) > sma(close, 100) and sma(close, 100) > sma(close, 200) and adx(high, low, close, 14) > 25 and roc(adx(high, low, close, 14), 1) > 0
strategy_roster.exit_long: sma(close, 10) <= sma(close, 20) or sma(close, 20) <= sma(close, 50) or sma(close, 50) <= sma(close, 100) or sma(close, 100) <= sma(close, 200)
strategy_roster.notes: All five documented SMA lengths and the ADX(14) above 25 with a rising value are kept, and any loss of strict ordering is the documented de-synchronisation exit. Requiring the order on the last three completed candles is not expressible without shifted bars, and the 100-point trailing stop is not a percentage field.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Signal ATR
strategy_roster.notes: The histogram is built with the documented Fast 9, Slow 15 and Signal 8 periods and the breakout band is the documented ThresholdMultiplier 0.004 times ATR(200); the same band on the other side is the reversal exit. TakeProfitPoints 10 and TrailingStopPoints 25 are instrument price steps, not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Dealers Trade ZeroLag MACD
strategy_roster.notes: Only the documented directional trigger is translated: a rising zero-lag MACD slope favours long accumulation, approximated by the MACD line's one-bar return with 12/26/9 fallbacks since the parameter table lists no values. Grid spacing, IntervalCoefficient scaling, SecureProfit, AccountProtection and MaximumBalance are position-management modules.

strategy_roster.name: Daily Range
strategy_roster.notes: The documented SlidingWindowDays of 3 becomes a three-bar high/low range and the OffsetCoefficient of 1 percent is applied to the breakout levels; RangeMode, the 10:05 session reset and MaxPositionsPerDay=3 are calendar or order-count fields. StopLossCoefficient 0.03 and TakeProfitCoefficient 0.05 scale with the range and are not fixed percentages.

strategy_roster.name: London BreakOut Classic
strategy_roster.notes: The 00:00-06:55 Asian box cannot be isolated without time fields, so a 20-bar prior range stands in and a close above its high is the documented long breakout; the documented stop at the box midpoint is the exit, with CRV=1 making the target symmetric. The 07:00-16:00 window is unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Rnd Trade
strategy_roster.notes: The EA closes the position and opens a new market position in a randomly selected direction on a fixed timer, so no deterministic market-derived signal exists; the impossible negative-price guard avoids fabricating one. IntervalMinutes and Volume are timer and sizing parameters.

strategy_roster.name: Vortex Indicator Duplex
strategy_roster.notes: The Vortex streams are unavailable, so the documented VI+ crossing VI- is proxied by directional dominance: a one-bar return crossing zero while ADX(14) confirms trend strength, with the mirror cross as the long exit. LongLength/SignalBar, the separate long/short candle types and the 1000/2000-step protections are not expressible here.

strategy_roster.name: SwingTrader
strategy_roster.notes: The documented BollingerPeriod 20 band bounce is kept with a bullish close at the lower band entering, and the middle-line cross from the source is used as the exit instead of a second entry filter. The martingale averaging grid, TakeProfitFactor 0.05 liquidation and Multiplier 1.5 volume scaling are position-management modules.
